title: isFastFailInTestMode defaults to true, killing games on card NPEs
description:
PlayerImpl.java sets isFastFailInTestMode = true by default. Because we run the server in test mode (normal XMage servers don't), the error recovery code in GameImpl.java takes the 'tests - try to fail fast' branch and kills the game thread on any card NPE instead of incrementing the error counter (up to 15 allowed errors) and continuing.

Fix: change default to false in PlayerImpl.java.
